claims: Jack Nicklaus is the oldest winner of The Masters.
Jack Nicklaus won his sixth Green Jacket in 1986 at 46 years, 2 months, and 23 days old.
Jack Nicklaus is known as the "Golden Bear".
Jack Nicklaus shot a final-round 65 at age 46.
Jack Nicklaus's 1986 Masters win was his 18th major championship.
Jack Nicklaus's 1986 Masters win was his final major championship.
Jack Nicklaus has held the record for oldest Masters winner since 1986.
Jack Nicklaus won the Masters in 1986 at 46 years, 82 days old.
Tiger Woods won the Masters in 2019 at 43 years, 3 months, 15 days old.
Ben Crenshaw won the Masters in 1995 at 43 years, 2 months, 29 days old.
Gary Player won the Masters in 1978 at 42 years, 5 months, 8 days old.
Sam Snead won the Masters in 1954 at 41 years, 10 months, 16 days old.
